All callers of isAvailable, reporterFor and reportedValue in production code now pass slotAvailabilityKey(slot, id), so player-side availability is keyed consistently (ShellLayout.tsx:184, :303, :330; FileDetailContainer.tsx:170).
potential_unspecified_behavior: Tab ids now contain a colon (`inspector-tabs:ask`). If InspectorShell builds DOM ids or CSS selectors from them, a colon would need escaping in querySelector. Not checked in InspectorShell.
regression_risks: Re-keying useSlotAvailability reports from a bare entry id to `player-side:<id>` changes the stored key. Any caller outside the files grepped that still passes a bare id would silently read 'available' (silence means available). Grep found none in frontend/src.

DocumentController.test.tsx covers non-null and identity for PDF and EPUB, and goTo routing (I9). goToSection.spec.ts covers reader-side bounds and the absence of a turned message.
LowerInspector.test.tsx covers half→peek, full→peek, no-op at peek, no-op on desktop and a stable identity.
